say.prompt: Correct the ambiguous lui by explicitly naming Nadia.

recall.prompt: Recall the departure time using sommes partis in the past.
recall.targetText: Nous sommes partis à neuf heures.

hear.prompt: Listen for the sequence marker introducing the first event in the account.

type.prompt: Type when the rain began relative to the group’s arrival.

write.prompt: Write the ending sequence: exhibition first, return afterward.
write.targetText: Finalement, nous avons vu l’exposition avant de rentrer.
